meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会把Python项目(Flask、Django、FastAPI等)部署到Azure的App Service Linux服务上。如果资源组、托管计划或Web应用没创建,它会自动补建。部署完就结束,不做健康检查。
howto.when: 当你说出“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等关键词,或要求“deploy Python to App Service”时触发;不用于容器应用、函数、非Python等场景。

say.text: 把当前这个Flask项目部署到Azure App Service
say.note: 它会自动创建缺失的资源组和计划

say.text: 帮我将Django应用部署到Azure App Service
say.note: 会检测框架并设置启动命令

howto.what_en: Deploys Python apps (Flask/Django/FastAPI) to Azure App Service Linux, auto-creating the RG, plan, and web app if absent. Ends after printing a post-deploy message; no verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'Flask App Service', 'Django App Service', 'FastAPI App Service', or 'deploy Python to App Service'. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, or full-infra tasks.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask project to Azure App Service.
say_en.note: Creates missing resource group and plan automatically.

say_en.text: Deploy my Django app to Azure App Service.
say_en.note: Detects framework and sets startup as needed.

say_en.text: Use azd to deploy my FastAPI project to App Service.
say_en.note: Uses azd deploy if azure.yaml is present.
